TOP: Citrix NetScaler SAML zero-day exploited in the wild
AWS AgentCore default tool runs as root, leaks JWT
Atlassian Data Center 9.3 file access flaw

P.h: Citrix NetScaler zero-day under active attack
P.p: A single crafted request knocks NetScaler ADC and Gateway offline through CVE-2026-88779, a memory overflow in appliances set up as a SAML service or identity provider. CISA confirmed active exploitation.
P.s: watchTowr suspects attackers crash appliances on purpose to speed up exploitation of CVE-2026-88771, one of eight bugs disclosed Sept 27. Patch, start with SAML-enabled Gateway and AAA servers, and treat a clean IOC scan as inconclusive.

items.h: AWS AgentCore default bash tool runs as root, leaks identity JWT
items.d: Unit 42 scanned the heap of an agent runtime and exfiltrated the AgentCore Identity token. Review default tools on agent platforms.

items.h: MALFEX npm campaign: 8 malicious packages, 3 still live
items.d: Overlord RAT and a stealer for Discord, browser, Telegram and wallet data. function-flag and function-color have no advisory yet.

items.h: kubectl cp lets a hostile container write to Windows Startup
items.d: CVE-2026-19444, CVSS 6.5. Windows clients need kubectl 1.36.5, 1.35.9 or 1.34.12. Cluster version does not matter.

items.h: MCP agent-to-agent prompt injection hits Google and others
items.d: Injected prompts were forwarded to internal agents and executed on trust, mostly ending in SSRF. Severity up to 8 in Google's mcp-toolbox.

P.h: Atlassian warns of critical Data Center file access flaw
P.p: CVE-2026-21589 scores 9.3 and hits several Data Center products, including Bitbucket and Confluence. Unauthenticated attackers can read files in the web root if they know the exact path.
P.s: Fixed versions are out. Patch now, or restrict external access and apply the published mitigations. Also note: the DNS root key signing key rolls over on Oct 11, so check DNSSEC resolvers trust KSK-2024.

tiles.t: Govern what AI agents do, not just what they can reach
tiles.d: Access control says if an identity may act. Agents need intent checks, audit trails and human approval for high-impact steps.
Models plus Teamwork Graph; Jira work assigned to agents.
Spend could hit $350B by 2027, squeezing margins and pushing smaller models and smarter routing.

P.h: Harden CI/CD: ephemeral runners, short-lived OIDC, pinned deps
P.p: Google's threat team lays out how to shrink supply-chain risk in build pipelines: ephemeral runners, short-lived OIDC credentials, immutable dependency references and provenance checks.
P.s: Isolate build caches by branch privilege, keep untrusted pull requests away from release secrets, and quarantine incoming dependencies. Cloudflare Birthday Week also shipped 46 launches, including a cf CLI and a path to its own public CA.

Check kernel, runtime and monitoring before upgrading.
